nonTargets.explanation: Department, credits, status, HP/SP and category labels without handlers are not pointer targets. Whole course cards are not click targets. Hidden/disabled controls are excluded; closed See more is excluded by visibility/display.

spacing.method: Radius 12 circle against every peer target bounding rectangle; extra radius-12 circle comparison for undersized peers. Rectangles overapproximate rounded/complex peers, so a negative rectangle clearance needs a shape/hit-test follow-up before FAIL.

assessment.hitEvidence: Use the sibling hit object on this observation

method: Search alternative axis-aligned 24px squares within the same unmodified target; target rounded-rectangle corner proof plus 676 real hit tests. Initial centered-square occlusion is preserved, not treated as proof that no square exists.
